name: Verify Session Ledger
summary: Verify the hash-chained session ledger and report exactly which entries, if any, fail integrity.
description: Invoked as a slash command, runs the deterministic chain verification over .youdede/session-ledger.jsonl and explains the result: entry count, first failing line, and what the failure means for trust in carried claims.
risk_reason: This command verifies the hash-chained session ledger and reports exactly which entries, if any, fail integrity; it does not transmit ledger content; the verdict carries counts and hashes only.
refuses: It does not repair, rewrite, or truncate the ledger; integrity failures are reported, not fixed.
It does not treat entries after a chain failure as verified, regardless of their content.
It does not transmit ledger content; the verdict carries counts and hashes only.
It does not claim authorship or resist an actor who can rewrite both the ledger and its local head seal.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate the declared preconditions deterministically before the workflow may begin.

produces: a ledger integrity verdict naming entry count, chain status, and the first failing line if any

operational.latency_reason: The command follows a precondition check and multiple workflow steps while it verifies the hash-chained session ledger and reports exactly which entries, if any, fail integrity.
